moved.text: Lagos plans a new permanent NYSC orientation camp; government said work would start on this proposed site.
moved.quote: work will begin earnestly on the proposed site of the ultra-modern NYSC Permanent Orientation Camp

notes.text: Current camp is one of the oldest and most challenging orientation facilities in Nigeria.
notes.quote: the new camp would replace one of the oldest and most challenging orientation facilities in the country

notes.text: The present facility is housed in Abubakar Dada Secondary School and suffers infrastructural decay.
notes.quote: currently located within Abubakar Dada Secondary School in Paiko, is plagued by infrastructural decay

notes.text: A new camp planned nearby will have solar power, a 3,000-seat hall and 41 hostel blocks.
notes.quote: solar -powered, off-grid sustainability, a 3,000-capacity hall, 41 hostel blocks

moved.text: Niger State is building a new permanent NYSC camp in Paiko, promised within 12 months.
moved.quote: The Niger State Government has pledged to deliver a new permanent orientation camp for the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) within the next 12 months

directions.text: Camp is located off Ado Ekiti-Ikare Road in Ikare-Akoko, Ondo.
directions.quote: located at Off Ado Ekiti-Ikare Road, Ikare-Akoko, Ondo

notes.text: The camp recently underwent a full renovation and transformation, described as a new look.
notes.quote: This video showcases the complete transformation and renovation of the National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) Permanent Orientation Camp in Ede

moved.text: Other sources list Plateau's permanent camp as Mangu LGA, but the current official camp is a temporary site in Jos South LGA.
moved.quote: The NYSC Permanent Orientation Camp in Plateau State is located at Mangu, Mangu Local Government Area, Plateau State.

notes.text: Corps members report plentiful water supply, even enough to wash directly in the bathroom.
notes.quote: water rush in the bathroom,we do even wash in the bathroom enjoy urself dear.welcome to rivers

notes.text: Mami Market inside camp run by locals sells food, drinks, and other camp needs.
notes.quote: There is the large market operated by the locals popularly called "Mami Market" where all camp needs are sold, including food and drinks.

notes.text: Expect very hot weather; one corps member called it the famous Sokoto heat.
notes.quote: The first thing that hit me was the thought of the famous Sokoto heat.

notes.text: Camp was renovated in 2026; multipurpose hall expanded to fit 3,000 corps members, but mattresses and solar lighting still needed.
notes.quote: the expansion of the multipurpose hall to accommodate 3,000 corps members, would smoothen activities... providing mattresses, solar lighting, a Hilux vehicle

notes.text: Camp is along Jalingo–Wukari road, about 15 km from Jalingo town.
notes.quote: located along Jalingo Wukari road about 15 km from Jalingo

notes.text: Camp is about 5 km from the airport.
notes.quote: 5 kilometers from the airport

notes.text: Corps members' hostel accommodation is well spaced out.
notes.quote: the coopers accommodation well spaced

directions.text: Camp is located on the Jalingo–Wukari road, around 15 km from Jalingo.
directions.quote: located along Jalingo Wukari road about 15 km from Jalingo

moved.text: Zamfara's permanent camp is at Tsafe LGA, but corps members currently use a temporary camp in Lalan, Gusau.
moved.quote: NYSC Permanent Orientation Camp, Beside FRSC Office, Tsafe Local Government Area, Zamfara State.
